import h5py
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import mne
from mne.filter import filter_data
from scipy.signal import hilbert
from scipy.stats import linregress
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Parameters
sessions = list(range(1, 11))
tmin, tmax = -0.1, 0.5
theta_band = (4, 7)
gamma_band = (30, 50)
bins = 18
n_boot = 1000

# Compute Tort's modulation index
def compute_mi(phase, amp, bins=18):
    edges = np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, bins + 1)
    avg_amp = np.zeros(bins)
    for i in range(bins):
        mask = (phase >= edges[i]) & (phase < edges[i+1])
        avg_amp[i] = amp[mask].mean() if np.any(mask) else 0.0
    if avg_amp.sum() > 0:
        P = avg_amp / avg_amp.sum()
    else:
        P = np.ones(bins) / bins
    P = np.where(P > 0, P, 1e-8)
    H = -np.sum(P * np.log(P))
    Hmax = np.log(bins)
    return (Hmax - H) / Hmax

session_mi = []
for sess in sessions:
    # Load MEG data
    fname = f"sub-0_ses-{sess}_meg.h5"
    with h5py.File(fname, 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][()]
        sfreq = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_names = [n.strip() for n in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
        ch_types = [t.strip() for t in f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')]
    info = mne.create_info(ch_names=ch_names, sfreq=sfreq, ch_types=ch_types)
    raw = mne.io.RawArray(data, info, verbose=False)

    # Load events and select word onsets
    evt = pd.read_csv(f"sub-0_ses-{sess}_events.tsv", sep='\t')
    word_times = evt.loc[evt.kind == 'word', 'timemeg'].values
    samples = np.round(word_times * sfreq).astype(int)
    events = np.column_stack((samples, np.zeros_like(samples, int), np.ones_like(samples, int)))

    # Epochs with baseline correction
    epochs = mne.Epochs(raw, events, event_id=1, tmin=tmin, tmax=tmax,
                        baseline=(None, 0), preload=True, verbose=False)
    data_epochs = epochs.get_data()  # shape (n_epochs, n_ch, n_times)
    times = epochs.times
    win_idx = np.where((times >= 0) & (times <= 0.3))[0]

    n_epochs, n_ch, _ = data_epochs.shape
    mis = np.zeros(n_ch)
    for ch in range(n_ch):
        sig = data_epochs[:, ch, :][:, win_idx].ravel()
        # Theta phase
        theta = filter_data(sig, sfreq, theta_band[0], theta_band[1], verbose=False)
        phase = np.angle(hilbert(theta))
        # Gamma envelope
        gamma = filter_data(sig, sfreq, gamma_band[0], gamma_band[1], verbose=False)
        amp = np.abs(hilbert(gamma))
        mis[ch] = compute_mi(phase, amp, bins)
    mean_mi = mis.mean()
    session_mi.append(mean_mi)
    print(f"Session {sess}: mean PAC (MI) = {mean_mi:.4f}")

# Linear regression of MI vs. session
x = np.array(sessions)
y = np.array(session_mi)
reg = linregress(x, y)
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, stderr = reg.slope, reg.intercept, reg.rvalue, reg.pvalue, reg.stderr
# Bootstrap CI for slope
slopes = []
for _ in range(n_boot):
    idx = np.random.choice(len(x), len(x), replace=True)
    xb, yb = x[idx], y[idx]
    slopes.append(linregress(xb, yb).slope)
lower, upper = np.percentile(slopes, [2.5, 97.5])

print(f"\nRegression result: slope = {slope:.4f}, p = {p_value:.4f}")
print(f"95% CI for slope: [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]")

# Plot MI trend with regression line and CI
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(x, y, 'o', label='Session MI')
xf = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 100)
plt.plot(xf, intercept + slope * xf, 'r-', label='Fit')
plt.fill_between(xf, intercept + lower * xf, intercept + upper * xf,
                 color='r', alpha=0.2, label='95% CI')
plt.xlabel('Session')
plt.ylabel('Mean PAC (MI)')
plt.title('Theta–Gamma PAC Across Sessions')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Summary table of MI per session
mi_table = pd.DataFrame({'session': sessions, 'MI': session_mi})
print('\nSession-wise MI values:')
print(mi_table.to_string(index=False))

{"code":"import h5py
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import mne
from mne.filter import filter_data
from scipy.signal import hilbert
from scipy.stats import linregress
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Parameters
sessions = list(range(1, 11))
tmin, tmax = -0.1, 0.5
theta_band = (4, 7)
gamma_band = (30, 50)
bins = 18
n_boot = 1000

# Compute Tort's modulation index
def compute_mi(phase, amp, bins=18):
    edges = np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, bins + 1)
    avg_amp = np.zeros(bins)
    for i in range(bins):
        mask = (phase >= edges[i]) & (phase < edges[i+1])
        avg_amp[i] = amp[mask].mean() if np.any(mask) else 0.0
    if avg_amp.sum() > 0:
        P = avg_amp / avg_amp.sum()
    else:
        P = np.ones(bins) / bins
    P = np.where(P > 0, P, 1e-8)
    H = -np.sum(P * np.log(P))
    Hmax = np.log(bins)
    return (Hmax - H) / Hmax

session_mi = []
for sess in sessions:
    # Load MEG data
    fname = f"sub-0_ses-{sess}_meg.h5"
    with h5py.File(fname, 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][()]
        sfreq = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_names = f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')
        ch_types = f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')
    info = mne.create_info(ch_names=ch_names, sfreq=sfreq, ch_types=ch_types)
    raw = mne.io.RawArray(data, info, verbose=False)

    # Load events and select word onsets
    evt = pd.read_csv(f"sub-0_ses-{sess}_events.tsv", sep='\t')
    word_times = evt.loc[evt.kind == 'word', 'timemeg'].values
    samples = np.round(word_times * sfreq).astype(int)
    events = np.column_stack((samples, np.zeros_like(samples, int), np.ones_like(samples, int)))

    # Epochs with baseline correction
    epochs = mne.Epochs(raw, events, event_id=1, tmin=tmin, tmax=tmax,
                        baseline=(None, 0), preload=True, verbose=False)
    data_epochs = epochs.get_data()  # (n_epochs, n_ch, n_times)
    times = epochs.times
    win_idx = np.where((times >= 0) & (times <= 0.3))[0]

    n_epochs, n_ch, _ = data_epochs.shape
    mis = np.zeros(n_ch)
    for ch in range(n_ch):
        sig = data_epochs[:, ch, :][:, win_idx].ravel()
        # Theta phase
        theta = filter_data(sig, sfreq, theta_band[0], theta_band[1], verbose=False)
        phase = np.angle(hilbert(theta))
        # Gamma envelope
        gamma = filter_data(sig, sfreq, gamma_band[0], gamma_band[1], verbose=False)
        amp = np.abs(hilbert(gamma))
        mis[ch] = compute_mi(phase, amp, bins)
    mean_mi = mis.mean()
    session_mi.append(mean_mi)
    print(f"Session {sess}: mean PAC (MI) = {mean_mi:.4f}")

# Regression
x = np.array(sessions)
y = np.array(session_mi)
reg = linregress(x, y)
slope, intercept, p_value, stderr = reg.slope, reg.intercept, reg.pvalue, reg.stderr
# Bootstrap CI
slopes = []
for _ in range(n_boot):
    idx = np.random.choice(len(x), len(x), replace=True)
    xb, yb = x[idx], y[idx]
    slopes.append(linregress(xb, yb).slope)
lower, upper = np.percentile(slopes, [2.5, 97.5])

print(f"\nRegression: slope = {slope:.4f}, p = {p_value:.4f}")
print(f"95% CI: [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]")

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(x, y, 'o', label='Session MI')
xf = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 100)
plt.plot(xf, intercept + slope * xf, 'r-', label='Fit')
plt.fill_between(xf, intercept + lower * xf, intercept + upper * xf,
                 color='r', alpha=0.2, label='95% CI')
plt.xlabel('Session')
plt.ylabel('Mean PAC (MI)')
plt.title('Theta–Gamma PAC Across Sessions')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# MI table
mi_table = pd.DataFrame({'session': sessions, 'MI': session_mi})
print('\nSession-wise MI values:')
print(mi_table.to_string(index=False))"}
